g.text: Independent Kimi cohort: each condition compared with never stored
n = 40 frozen evaluation contexts; 95% paired whole-record bootstrap intervals. Qualification failures included.
Positive target differences indicate residual readout. Retained and continuation differences measure drift; continuations use a six-passage synthetic probe bank.
